title: Oracle Application Testing Suite DownloadServlet reportName Parameter Directory Traversal Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to exfiltrate arbitrary files on vulnerable installations of Oracle Application Testing Suite. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the DownloadServlet. By providing a reportName parameter containing a directory traversal where the downloadType is specified as report, an attacker can exfiltrate arbitrary files from the system.
